claim_text: We are focused on managing our impact on nature, including water, biodiversity, air and surrounding ecosystems.
metric_name: Water performance actions completion; Land disturbed; Progressive rehabilitation; Conservation set-aside
context_text: We are focused on managing our impact on nature, including water, biodiversity, air and surrounding ecosystems.；In FY25, the water performance actions were 100% complete at Australia Manganese, Cannington and Hillside Aluminium, and 92% complete at Cerro Matoso.；In FY25, 175ha of land was disturbed, approximately 221ha was progressively rehabilitated, and almost 3,800ha was set aside for conservation.
label: Partially Supported
rationale_short: 报告提供了水管理完成率、土地扰动、修复和保育数据，表明公司确有一定自然管理行动；但对空气、周边生态系统和整体自然影响管理的证据并不完整，因此只能部分支撑。
notes: 覆盖面广于已提供绩效证据。
